_overridesNote.@softarc/native-federation: REMOVED 2026-09-16 (issue #53): the override existed only to collapse the tree onto one copy, and the sole reason a second copy ever appeared was the dead @softarc/native-federation-node dependency (pinned EXACTLY 4.1.3, imported nowhere, end-of-life upstream). With that dependency deleted, @angular-architects/native-federation is the only consumer and the lockfile resolves ONE hoisted copy from its own range with no override. Do not re-add a bare pin here -- npm applies overrides without resolution, so a stale pin installs green and rots silently (this one sat at 4.3.2 under a consumer requiring ^4.4.0 until the production build broke on a missing /internal export).
_overridesNote.mocha.diff: REMOVED 2026-09-18 (issue #71): the pin was added 2026-07-08 (e1453fb) to close an npm-audit advisory against `diff`, but npm applies overrides by package name only, so `8.0.4` was forced onto EVERY nested `diff` under a `mocha` parent regardless of what that mocha actually declared -- and it never once matched: mocha 11's bundled diff wanted ^7, mocha 12 (this bump) wants ^9, and nightwatch's own nested mocha 10.8.2 wants ^5.2.0. `npm audit` on this tree shows no advisory for `diff` at all, so the pin is not closing anything live. Removed rather than re-pinned so each nested diff resolves to the range its own mocha declares; re-verify with `npm ls diff` after any future mocha bump instead of re-adding a bare version override here.

_overridesNote2.qs: ADDED 2026-10-15 (issue #72): a floor, not a pin. express and body-parser@2 allow qs ^6.16, but the dev-only express 4 and body-parser 1 copies ask for ~6.15.1 and kept the one hoisted copy on 6.15.3, which `npm audit` flags (GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g) on the runtime path of server.js. scripts/check-runtime-audit.mjs fails when a runtime advisory reappears.
_overridesNote2.nightwatch-html-reporter: REMOVED 2026-11-04 (issue #72): nothing loaded it. Every e2e script passes `-r ./e2e/html-reporter.js`, this repo's own handlebars reporter, and nightwatch.conf.js names no reporter package. It was the only parent of nconf 0.8.5 (GHSA-6xwr-q98w-rvg7, whose audit 'fix' was a semver-major DOWNGRADE of the reporter to 0.1.1), pug 2.0.4 (GHSA-p493-635q-r6gr, GHSA-3965-hpx2-q597) and xml2js 0.4.23 (GHSA-776f-qx25-q3cc). The `pug-code-gen` override existed only for that pug and is removed with it. scripts/runtime-lock-floors.test.mjs fails if any of the four reappears in the lockfile.
